From: Lina Park <lina@orbital-cloud.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: procurements@orbital-cloud.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orbital Cloud — vendor intake + billing questions for marketplace listing

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Attached is our completed vendor intake (Vendor_Onboarding_Form_Orbital.pdf) and a copy of our incorporation docs. We're targeting a soft go-live on the AWS marketplace on Sep 6 and want to make sure we don't miss any procurement dependencies on your side.

Two quick questions:
- Do you require a signed PO (from Redwood) before we can publish on the AWS Marketplace, or can we proceed with a marketplace listing and follow up with a PO for monthly settlement?
- Who is the billing contact / invoice recipient for marketplace purchases (AWS vs Azure vs GCP differ for us)? We have to wire bank details for some channels and need to know how Redwood will accept invoices.

I've attached the intake and incorporation files. If helpful I can also send a redline of your standard PO terms (PO_Terms_Orbital.docx).

Best,
Lina Park
Head of Partnerships
Orbital Cloud

Attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Form_Orbital.pdf (PDF, 412 KB); Proof_of_Incorporation.pdf (PDF, 220 KB)

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Lina Park <lina@orbital-cloud.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 18:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Orbital Cloud — vendor intake + billing questions for marketplace listing

Hi Lina — thanks for the files and the target date. Short answer up front: we can list on AWS/Azure/GCP before a Redwood PO is issued, but for billing reconciliation and for Dedicated/private contract alignment we will need a signed PO or invoice routing to our finance team before first settlement. The exact flow depends on which marketplace path you take (AWS seller vs AWS channel partner).

Next steps I propose (owner in parentheses):
1) Confirm marketplace path (are you a direct AWS seller or listing via a channel partner?) — Orbital (you)
2) Complete the vendor intake PDF with banking/tax info and return signed — Orbital (you already sent most of it; the banking page is blank)
3) Redwood finance to raise draft PO and share for signature (Vanessa) — (vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai)
4) Channel Ops sync to map SKU / billing descriptors for marketplace invoice matching — (Lauren)

Vanessa — can you prep a draft PO template we typically use for AWS listings? If there are any exceptions for GCP/Azure we should note them in the PO notes.

Lina — can you confirm the legal entity name exactly as it should appear on the PO, and whether you have an EIN or VAT id for EU/UK sales? Also please attach the banking instructions (wire details) if you expect direct settlement for any channel.

I'll loop Channel Ops after Vanessa shares the PO draft.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

--

Markus / Lina — looping in procurement ops details.

Lina, quick procurement notes to avoid last-minute gating when you publish:
- For AWS Marketplace (Direct Seller): we typically allow the listing to go live while the vendor intake is in progress, but we will hold settlement until the signed PO or a valid Redwood invoicing profile is on file. That means we need the completed intake + either: a) a signed PO (preferred) or b) a registered billing contact + remit-to email and invoice template for automated processing.
- For Azure/GCP: both marketplaces sometimes require different "bill to" metadata. Please confirm which SKUs will be sold through each channel so we can pre-map descriptors for automated invoice matching.
- Tax forms: if you are a US company, upload a W-9. If non-US, we need a W-8BEN or applicable VAT registration.
- Banking: we prefer vendors on ACH for domestic settlements; for international banks we accept wire but need IBAN/SWIFT.

DocuSign: I'll push a Redwood PO draft to a DocuSign template once Markus confirms the PO type (standard monthly settlement). Lina, you'll get an email where you can sign the PO.

I created a short checklist in our shared drive: https://redwood.sh/drive/marketplace-onboard/ORBIT-2026-07-023 — please drop the filled banking page there.

Thanks — Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: PO_Terms_Orbital.docx (if you want to send redlines we'll review but standard terms apply)
